title: Folder Kit Store Reads From SQLite Kit Db
description: Change FolderKitStore to read/write kit data from .semio/kit.db SQLite file instead of .semio/kit.json. Update KitFolderAdapter, desktop main.ts IPC handlers, and all consumers.
summary: Changed FolderKitStore to read/write kit data from .semio/kit.db SQLite database instead of .semio/kit.json JSON file. Exported getSqlJs, sqliteToKit, kitToSqlite from @semio/js. Updated KitFolderAdapter interface to use Uint8Array binary data. Updated FolderKitStore.create(), save(), and reload() to use SQLite serialization via sql.js. Updated desktop main.ts IPC handlers to read/write .semio/kit.db as binary. Updated desktop preload.ts and renderer.tsx for binary kit data. Updated all 17 FolderKitStore tests for SQLite format. Fixed pre-existing circular dependency bug where module-level guid() calls in tutorial constants caused test suite failure (replaced with static IDs). All 17 FolderKitStore tests pass.
